text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Shakur-chan's over there. With how things 
are developing, now's the time to make a 
move—!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(So put your whole heart into it, with all 
your might...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile Championship was wonderful. I'm 
rooting for your hard work, Dantsu!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you lately always gives me 
energy. Makes me feel like I gotta do my 
best too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's why you never waver. That's why 
you're strong."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's a special girl, one capable of 
becoming the leading figure of a new era!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll win, I'm going to win--!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I am the staaaaaaaaaaaar!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Dantsu Flaaame!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Holy crap, that gave me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame was so on fire...!! Man, that 
was insane! I had no idea she was like 
that!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Me too... To be honest, I didn't expect 
much from a Takarazuka Kinen without 
Pokke, but—"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame, you're the greatest--!!

From all across the stands came shouts 
praising Dants Flame and a tempest of 
applause—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: W-Wah—

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: (I want to win even more.)

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win more and shine the 
brightest. To stand in the center and 
become the star.)

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: (If I do that, then surely—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I became... special.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Like back then again—no.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Even more, more, more than that—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having grown by leaps and bounds time and 
again since her debut, she seized this 
victory brilliantly with her own two 
hands!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much... My heart is just so 
full right now...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everything up until now, every single bit! 
I crammed in everything I could possibly 
think of!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And then, before I knew it— I-I had 
won...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"At the very end, I was running together 
with you, Trainer. We ran together, and we 
won—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That is why I was able to become the lead 
role!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: We did it. Really, truly...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enveloped in a profound sense of 
achievement and a gentle euphoria—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —*Sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...The data from tomorrow onward is 
different. The turning point—is it 
'today'?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She went and changed it. Aw, man... 
Dammit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There's a certain scene from the Twinkle 
Series that I occasionally remember.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan and Pokke-chan's graded race. 
Like Tachyon-chan's flash-of-light run in 
the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan's Japanese Derby. Cafe-chan's 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was just so, so incredible, and 
truly, so sparkly and shiny――

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still... I feel like today, I was finally 
able to stand alongside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And if I can push through with everything 
I've got right now—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking maybe... I can take things 
one step further.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really feel like I can become a 
one-of-a-kind protagonist!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Would you like 
to go?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To the grand stage— somewhere like... the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)— A historic 
battleground where contenders vie for the 
highest honor in turf medium-distance 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm going to surge forward. Farther 
and farther, as far as I can possibly 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deep within the eyes peering my way —sure 
enough, a fierce flame was burning.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's go! To the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Aiming for even greater heights, I want to 
climb all the way to the top!"
